claude.sample_unit: prostate cancer articles (lay summaries per prompt)

links.outcome: Readability (FKRE) of AI lay summaries with simple vs extended plain-language prompt vs original
links.effect: Median FKRE extended prompt 47 (IQR 42-56), simple prompt 36 (29-43), original 20 (9.5-29); P<.001. High-quality: 79.4% extended, 54.9% simple, 5.4% original.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4-generated lay summaries showed an improvement in readability compared to human-written versions, with the extended prompt achieving higher scores than the simple prompt (median FKRE: extended prompt 47, IQR 42-56; simple prompt 36, IQR 29-43; original 20, IQR 9.5-29; P<.001).

links.outcome: Reading level of lay summaries with prompt targeting 6th-grade level vs simple prompt vs author-written
links.effect: Median FKGL 12 (extended), 14 (simple), 16 (original); reading age 19, 21, 23 years; all P<.001. Extended prompt targeted sixth-grade level but still did not reach it.
links.quote: Compared to the original lay summaries, those generated by ChatGPT-4 (using both simple and extended prompts) exhibited improved readability metrics, generally higher factual accuracy, and better adherence to the predefined correct word count.

links.outcome: Factual accuracy of AI lay summaries rated by 2 blinded experts on 5-point Likert scale
links.effect: Median accuracy 5 (IQR 5-5) for both prompts vs 5 (4-5) original; P<.001. Both raters <4: 1 (0.5%) extended, 1 (0.5%) simple, 12 (5.9%) original.
links.quote: Factual accuracy was higher for the AI-generated lay summaries compared to originals (median factual accuracy score: extended prompt 5, IQR 5-5; simple prompt 5, IQR 5-5; original 5, IQR 4-5; P<.001) in this dataset.

links.outcome: Effect of prompt design on summary quality, comparing simple vs extended prompt
links.effect: Extended prompt gave higher readability and more high-quality summaries (79.4% vs 54.9%); no significant difference in accuracy (P=.53) or word count compliance (P=.87).
links.quote: Between simple and extended prompts, there were no significant differences in accuracy (P=.53) and word count compliance (P=.87).
